title: An exponent with no mantissa is a string, whatever the sign
notes: The core schema float pattern needs at least one digit before the exponent: `[-+]? ( \. [0-9]+ | [0-9]+ ( \. [0-9]* )? ) ( [eE] [-+]? [0-9]+ )?`. A sign and an exponent alone match nothing, so every item is a string.

provenance.reference: A resolver that read a sign and an exponent without a mantissa as a float: `+e5` became 0 and `-E1` became negative zero.
